request.prompt:
Create one isolated, full-body game-character production prototype for Mass Effect — Armax Relay Clash, using the attached original game reference as the visual authority. Faithfully reproduce the specific original model, its anatomy, proportions, materials, color blocking, equipment placement and asymmetry. Detailed realistic game-render finish, crisp readable silhouette, even studio lighting with subtle material highlights. Output exactly ONE character and ONE view, with the complete head, body, every limb, weapon and feet inside the image and generous transparent padding on all sides. Genuine transparent RGBA background, no ground plane, no cast floor shadow, no scene, no frame, no contact sheet, no text, no captions, no publisher logos. The attached sheet is a reference for the single figure, not a layout to reproduce. Preserve model-side asymmetry; do not mirror the reference. Do not add equipment, insignia, effects or redesigned parts. This is a still pose, not an animation sheet.

Subject: male Shepard wearing the full Terminus Assault Armor from Mass Effect 2, helmet on, based on this original EA promotional artwork. Reproduce the male armor silhouette and the same nearly frontal, slightly angled, two-handed low firearm carry shown in the reference, with the same visible weapon shape. Preserve the tall fully enclosed sharply angular helmet, dark visor slits and tapered faceplate, angular pale gunmetal chest and shoulder plates, charcoal-black ribbed undersuit, fine dark-red panel seams, broad layered forearm armor, pointed outer thigh panels and distinctive long angular armored shin guards and boots. Maintain the dark charcoal/gunmetal palette without changing it to white armor or glowing red armor. Use brighter neutral studio lighting to make the original dark surfaces readable, while retaining their materials and layout. Remove the promotional scene and lettering entirely. Match the armor visible around the gun instead of inventing new chest emblems. Both complete boots and helmet top must have clear transparent margin.
